about: Round 2 B upstream selection (#375): the full select and its resume, merged for the frozen task set

rule.order: repositories in rank order; commits by time descending, full SHA ascending
rule.caps: B and C caps counted separately (pre-registration: at most 6 per repository, C: 4)
rule.dev: after C's final tasks, in the same order: the next B-size commits for B, then the next C-size commits for C; a group's development tasks count toward that group's repository cap; a shortfall is filled by authored development tasks (#371)
notes: commits before the date limit are recorded as one count per repository
pure Python is checked on the repository HEAD (no .c/.pyx/.rs/... file anywhere)
pytest plugins are not autoloaded; PYTHONPATH is src/ (if present) then the root; a task's src_layout tells the evaluation run to do the same
commits changing test support files or deleting/renaming tests are excluded
install-time version files the parent's pyproject.toml declares are written as stubs (task `stubs`); validation, run and scoring use PYTHONUTF8=1 (task `pythonutf8`) (#415)

the 10-minute suite limit is read as a repository condition (pre-registration section 2 lists it among the repository conditions but says 'on the parent'): after the first candidate whose parent's full suite times out, the repository's other candidates are excluded; tasks already taken from it stay; a repository near the limit can lose its other candidates to one slow run (#424)

pytest plugins: the --ext-python pytest11 entry points of distributions the parent declares (pyproject dependencies, test/tests/testing/dev extras and dependency groups, setup.cfg install_requires and those extras, requirements files, extras the project asks of itself such as `pkg[cov]` or `-e .[test]`; not the task's own distribution) plus the project's own pytest11 entry points, loaded with PYTEST_PLUGINS (task `pytest_plugins`); autoload stays off; never loaded: pytest-randomly, pytest-random-order, pytest-enabler, pytest-rerunfailures, pytest-retry, flaky, pytest-ignore-flaky; not read: setup.py (extras_require, tests_require); [tool.poetry] dependencies and groups; [tool.hatch.envs] dependencies; [tool.pdm.dev-dependencies]; tox.ini deps (#424)
declared() reads the dev groups too, while prepare installs only the test extras and the test/tests/testing/dev dependency groups; a plugin not installed is not loaded

version stubs report the leading v?digits.digits... of the nearest parent tag that starts with a version (`git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*' --match '[0-9]*'`), else 0.0 (task `stub_version`) (#424)
rule.installed_overlap: the task's own distribution in --ext-python and every vendored copy of it (#417; vendored copies: every folder named _vendor/vendor/_vendored/vendored under --ext-python's site-packages, user site (when enabled) and ensurepip's bundled wheels, and in every .whl there (e.g. virtualenv's embedded pip/setuptools wheels), is read without changing it; each top-level package or module in such a folder is one copy, and so is each top-level package of a .whl; a copy is named by its folder or module and by the distributions *.dist-info top_level.txt maps to it; its version comes from vendor.txt (matched by name), *.dist-info METADATA, else __version__; a copy belongs to a task when one of its names equals the task's project or a top-level package of the parent's tree (root or src/ only, tests/docs/setup excluded); a file or wheel that cannot be read is a scan error); new lines = lines the commit adds to code files, stripped, at least 30 characters, not comments, found nowhere in the parent's code files; excluded when at least 2 new lines, or all of them (at least one), appear in the installed package's .py files together with its vendored copies' .py files; an installed package whose files cannot be read, or a vendored copy of it with an unreadable file, is excluded as unknown; scan errors that belong to no copy (a folder that cannot be listed, a wheel that cannot be read) do not exclude commits, are listed once in vendored_scan_errors and make env-check fail
rule.hidden: commit's added/changed test files: parent fails (rc 1/2), commit passes, parent's existing suite passes

sources.note: full outputs (with every pytest error line) and the raw pytest outputs stay local (.ccx/eval/round2-select/); checked candidates here keep exit codes, summaries and raw-output hashes

scripts.freeze-pip-375-bc.py:
"""Freeze --ext-python's `pip list` into its own file (prepare's pip_list came back unreadable once; same command)."""
import json, subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.argv[1], "-m", "pip", "list", "--format=json", "--disable-pip-version-check"],
                   capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", check=True)
rows = sorted(({"name": d["name"], "version": d["version"]} for d in json.loads(r.stdout)), key=lambda d: d["name"].lower())
open(sys.argv[2], "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(json.dumps({"command": "python -m pip list --format=json",
                                                                      "pip_list": rows}, indent=1) + "\n")
print(len(rows))
scripts.resume-repos-375-bc.py:
"""The kept repositories the full select could not walk (git log failed), in rank order; check they are the tail."""
import json, sys
repos = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
sel = json.load(open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8"))
failed = [e["repo"] for e in sel["exclusions"] if e["reason"].startswith("not in --ext-cache")]
kept = repos["kept"]
order = [k["repo"] for k in kept]
idx = sorted(order.index(r) for r in failed)
tail = order[idx[0]:]
print("failed", len(failed), "first rank", kept[idx[0]]["rank"], "tail length", len(tail), "tail == failed:", tail == [order[i] for i in idx])
out = {**repos, "kept": [k for k in kept if k["repo"] in set(failed)], "excluded": [],
       "resume_note": "the kept repositories the full select of 2026-11-18 could not walk (git log failed transiently)"}
open(sys.argv[3], "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(json.dumps(out, indent=2) + "\n")
print(len(out["kept"]))
scripts.resume-select-375-bc.py:
"""Resume of the 2026-11-18 B selection over the 51 repositories it could not walk (#375): the same
`round2_tasks.py select`, with the B target set to the 24 tasks still missing and the run stopping once B is full
(C moved to round 3; no development tasks)."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts/eval")
import round2_tasks as R

R.B_TAKE, R.C_TAKE, R.B_DEV_TAKE, R.C_DEV_TAKE = 24, 0, 0, 0
raise SystemExit(R.main(["select", *sys.argv[1:]]))
